data.name: SettingsRuntimeIntro
data.value: IntentRoute AI does not include or download sing-box. Every launch requires re-approving your separately installed and verified v1.13+ executable through Browse.

data.name: SettingsRuntimePathTooltip
data.value: Approved path, or a discovery candidate awaiting your approval through Browse

data.name: SettingsAiHealthIntro
data.value: Runs a credential-free check against the provider and model selected on the AI page: OpenAI reports only whether the key is present and never sends a request; Ollama touches only the literal loopback address.

data.name: SettingsProxyIntro
data.value: Only SOCKS5 / HTTP / HTTPS proxies already listening on a literal loopback address are supported; no proxy nodes or accounts are provided.

data.name: SettingsProxyTestHint
data.value: The test only checks whether the local port accepts a connection. It sends no credentials and does not imply authentication or real-traffic success.

data.name: SettingsLanguageIntro
data.value: The display language applies after restart. Chinese is the default; after switching to English the Settings page static text is shown in English while other pages and dynamic messages remain Chinese.

data.name: SettingsLanguageRestartHint
data.value: Language preference saved. It takes effect after restarting the app.
